items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: I remember when Zachary Scott came there man, and they bused him, he went to jail.

ctx.x: That's a good point. Did white people come to the Dew Drop?

They'll sell them man. I remember when Zachary Scott came there man, and they bused him, he went to jail. Him and Frank and all of them. Oh really? Just because he was a movie star, Zachary Scott. I'm quite aware of him I'd have told you about that.
No but I know I've got stuff from the newspaper. Yeah man, yeah.
